# no ChHlthSt_2324
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(GGally)

no_ChHlth_model <- lm(grades_2324 ~ 1 
+LowBWght_2324+PhysAct_2324+Cond2more_2324+CSHCN_2324+ADHDind_2324+ADHDSevInd_2324 + +bullied_2324+bully_2324+MakeFriend_2324+MEDB10ScrQ5_2324+povlev4_2324+FoodSit_2324+FoodCash_2324+HousingInstab_2324 + famstruct5_2324+age5_2324+sex_2324+MedCare_2324+MentHCare_2324+SpEducPln_2324+ReptGrade_2324, data = df_23_24_clean)

anova(no_ChHlth_model)

# R- Squared Value
summary(no_ChHlth_model)$r.squared 
summary(no_ChHlth_model)$adj.r.squared
```
